newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.
Vessels: Panormitis loading 14,000 tonnes using big bags. Windstar loading 14,000 tonnes using big bags. Waiting to dock, six vessels to load using big bags and two to load bulk.
Road: 263 trucks carrying sugar arrived between June 13 and 15. Loading: 8,495 tonnes.
Vessels: A. Alandar loading 20,000 tonnes bulk sugar, Symplea loading 13,000 tonnes bagged sugar, Fulvia, Tong Cheng, Turn Stone and Daiana P each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar.
Waiting to dock, one vessel to load bagged sugar and two to load bulk. At Cargill private terminal, Gemstar I loading 14,000 bagged sugar. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load bulk sugar.
Stocks: 36,037 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
